properties.areaDesc: Municipality of Skagway; Haines Borough and Klukwan
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 18 at 1:04PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
A strong storm system is expected to move into the northern half of
the Alaska Panhandle and the northeast Gulf Coast Monday night and
continue through Tuesday. Beginning Monday night for Haines,
Skagway, and the two highways, periods of moderate to heavy rain
will move over the area. Total rain accumulation are expected to be
between 1.5-3.0 inches, with the heaviest rain late Tuesday morning
into Tuesday afternoon. While substantial areal flooding is not
expected at this time, isolated instances of minor ponding of water
in low lying areas is possible. Furthermore, wet snow is possibly on
the Klondike Highway near White Pass up to 3 inches, though warm
surface temperatures may hinder these snow totals.

NWSheadline: HEAVY RAIN EXPECTED MONDAY NIGHT THROUGH TUESDAY
